program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),     # diff pair gm/Id (weak inversion for gm efficiency)
    "L1":    (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),        # diff pair L (gain + flicker)
    "gmid3": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),      # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "L3":    (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),        # PMOS mirror L (gain)
    "gmidT": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),      # tail / reference mirror gm/Id
    "LT":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # tail L (CMRR)
    "Itail": (7e-6, 5.5e-6, 8e-6),   # tail current (slew vs power)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    vdd = 1.8
    It = p["Itail"]
    Ih = It / 2

    # Reference diode and tail mirror: same gm/Id, same L, same vds
    mref = lut.size("n", p["gmidT"], p["LT"], iref, vds=0.5)
    mtail = lut.size("n", p["gmidT"], p["LT"], It, vds=0.5)

    # Differential pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Ih, vds=0.6, vsb=0.35)

    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], Ih, vds=0.6)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mtail)
    # Diode side of the mirror on the vinp branch -> vinp is non-inverting
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout = m1.gds + m3.gds
    A0 = gm1 / gout
    cout = cl + m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m3.cgd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)

    # Mirror pole with doublet zero at 2*p_m
    cx = 2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    pm_hz = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cx)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pm_hz)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * pm_hz)))

    slew = It / cout
    power = vdd * (iref + It)

    # 5T OTA CMRR ~ 2*gm1*gm3 / (gds_tail * (gds1+gds3)) -> ~ A0 * 2*gm3/gdsT
    cmrr = db(A0 * 2 * m3.gm / mtail.gds) - 6
    psrr = db(A0) - 3

    # Noise: thermal plus rough flicker estimate
    k = 1.38e-23 * 300
    th = 16 * k / (3 * gm1) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    area1 = m1.W * m1.L
    area3 = m3.W * m3.L
    fl = 2 * (1.0e-10 / area1) + 2 * (3e-11 / area3) * (m3.gm / gm1) ** 2
    noise = math.sqrt(th + fl)

    # Swing: low = Vcm - Vgs1 + Vdsat1 (+margin), high = VDD - Vdsat4 (-margin)
    vs = vcm - m1.vgs
    vlo = vs + m1.vdsat + 0.05
    vhi = vdd - m3.vdsat - 0.05
    swing = vhi - vlo

    # Settling: slew portion plus linear 1% settling
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 0.3 / slew + 4.6 * tau

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A0),
        "ugbw": ugbw,
        "pm": pm,
        "slew": slew,
        "power": power,
        "cmrr_db": cmrr,
        "psrr_db": psrr,
        "noise_1k": noise,
        "swing": swing,
        "settle": settle,
    }
